q2: SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWER) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not semantically equivalent because Q1 groups by FOLLOWEE and then orders by FOLLOWER, while Q2 groups by FOLLOWEE and orders by FOLLOWEE. The difference arises when there are multiple followers for the same followee, as Q1 will order by the first follower encountered, while Q2 will order by the followee itself.
